## Madrid 3-Month Rental Priorities

A 3-month stay in Madrid is usually best handled as a furnished mid-term rental with clear internet and utility terms. With your budget, the strongest fit is a 1-bedroom in a well-connected neighborhood that keeps metro travel to central Madrid under 35 minutes.

## Best-Fit Rental Checklist

- **Budget ceiling:** €1,600/month total, including any mandatory fees
- **Lease length:** 3 months starting **2026-07-01**
- **Layout:** 1 bedroom, not a studio
- **Work setup:** proper desk, chair, and natural light if possible
- **Internet:** reliable Wi‑Fi with a stated speed or recent proof
- **Commute:** under 35 minutes by metro to central Madrid
- **Furnishing:** move-in ready, ideally with kitchen basics and laundry
- **Building essentials:** elevator if needed, quiet unit, good heating/AC
- **Contract clarity:** written terms for deposit, utilities, cleaning, and extension options

## What to Prioritize vs. What to Avoid

| Priority | What to look for | Red flags |
|---|---|---|
| Location | Near a metro line with direct or one-transfer access to central Madrid | “Close to metro” but no station name or commute time |
| Internet | Fiber or high-speed Wi‑Fi, ideally with router in-unit | “Wi‑Fi included” but no speed, no provider, or shared connection |
| Workspace | Separate desk, ergonomic chair, outlet access, good lighting | Dining table only, no chair, or workspace in a hallway/bedroom corner |
| Contract | Clear 3-month term, written deposit and utility rules | Vague “flexible” terms, verbal-only promises, hidden fees |
| Budget | All-in monthly cost within €1,600 | Cleaning, agency, or utility charges that push it over budget |
| Noise/comfort | Quiet street, double glazing, good insulation | Bars below, thin walls, street-facing party zone |
| Commute | Verified metro route under 35 minutes to central Madrid | “Fast access” without checking actual journey time |

## Neighborhoods to Consider

- **Arganzuela / Delicias / Legazpi:** practical, central-adjacent, often good metro access
- **Chamberí / Moncloa area:** convenient for central commute, but prices can rise
- **Tetuán / Cuatro Caminos:** strong transport links and more options in budget
- **Retiro / Ibiza edges:** pleasant and central, but availability may be tighter
- **Salamanca outer edges:** comfortable and well-located, though often pricier

## Sample Message to Landlords

Hello,

I’m looking for a furnished 1-bedroom rental in Madrid for **3 months starting 2026-07-01**. My budget is **up to €1,600/month**.

I work remotely, so I need:
- a proper workspace with desk and chair
- reliable Wi‑Fi
- a commute of **under 35 minutes by metro to central Madrid**

Could you please confirm:
- total monthly cost, including utilities and any fees
- exact metro station and estimated commute time
- Wi‑Fi speed/provider
- deposit amount and contract terms
- whether the apartment is fully furnished and available for the full 3 months

If available, I’d be happy to arrange a viewing or receive a video tour.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: View Madrid areas] https://www.renfe.com/es/en
Action: [Button: Check metro routes] https://www.metrodemadrid.es/en
Action: [Button: Search rentals] https://www.idealista.com/en/

## Sources

- Madrid Metro official site: https://www.metrodemadrid.es/en
- Madrid city transport info: https://www.esmadrid.com/en
- Rental search reference: https://www.idealista.com/en/
